title: Many Lives, Many Deaths
author: Mukul Kumar
text:
Time is a dense cloud that can
rain countless times,
the patters echoing the
reality of earth-
the resounding reassurance of
the sure-footedness;
The gleeful gusto.

Time is a dense cloud that can
instantly vanish at the mere
touch of a gust-
the sudden burst of
the unlived breaths,
the wisps conveying the
illusion of sky;
The gnawing gloom.

Between the countless and cipher,
There lie many lives, many deaths.
